motion_calibration_status: USER_RECALIBRATED_XYZ_2026-07-31: four-corner XY affine plus contact Z plane from tip-down ground touches; pick/release heights remain absolute at paper center and follow the plane elsewhere

sources.home_pose: User selected project HOME [175,0,210,-90,0,0] for the complete-paper view. HOME keeps its independent 3000 ms duration, and run startup sends it as the first NexArm protocol write after opening the serial port.
sources.position_tolerance_mm: User approved 10 mm after repeat stable feedback [168,5,219,-86.7,0,0] produced 8.66 mm position error
sources.paper_to_robot_matrix: Refitted 2026-07-31 evening from user tip-down corner measurements on the latest K230 frame: image TL(111,1)/paper(0,0)->(335,152,-33), TR(1116,2)/paper(0,297)->(345,-132,-35), BL(120,697)/paper(210,0)->(143,148,-20), BR(1120,691)/paper(210,297)->(137,-134,-21). Affine XY least-squares residual about 4.03 mm RMS.
sources.surface_z: Least-squares contact plane z=a*paper_x+b*paper_y+c fitted on the same four tip-down ground touches; residual about 0.25 mm RMS. When surface_z_plane_mm is present, pick_height/release_height are the absolute robot Z at surface_z_ref_paper_mm (A4 center 105,148.5); other paper points use z = height + (plane(x,y)-plane(ref)).
sources.wrist: NexArm roll convention confirmed on 2026-07-31 real runs: positive roll is counter-clockwise and negative roll is clockwise when viewed from above. wrist_roll_sign=+1 maps paper-plane rotation_delta directly onto that command sense. The final release command also applies the pintu base-swing correction: abs(normalized release azimuth minus pickup azimuth) multiplied by swing_roll_sign=+1, using the final commanded robot XY values. Run 20260730_214249_592518 showed both signs at -1 inverted every piece; both were flipped to +1.
sources.heights: pick_height and release_height remain the absolute low-pose targets at the paper-center reference (currently -12/-8). With the contact plane loaded, far/near corners automatically lower/raise by the active surface_z_plane_mm slope.
sources.pick_xy: pick_robot_xy_offset_mm reset to [0,0] for the fresh corner recalibration; reintroduce only after a physical center miss is observed on the new matrix.
sources.transfer: The Q1 executor follows pintu/jetson_to_nexarm/puzzle_runner.py: pick-ready at pick Z+40, descend, magnet on, lift at the pick XY to Z=120, rotate to the compensated release roll at Z=120, transit at Z=120, place-ready at release Z+40, descend, magnet off, and lift at the release XY to Z=120. Base move/descend/lift/rotate durations are 1500/800/800/1200 ms; rotate duration scales with the normalized roll delta and is skipped below 1 degree.
sources.magnet: STM32 USART1 application uses 115200 8N1 commands and a 50..500 ms timed MAGNET_ON lease. The by-id path ending 5B7A030191 is user-provided deployment data and must be rechecked on Jetson. Production sequence is pick-duration-plus-settle -> MAGNET_ON/status-confirm -> release-duration-plus-settle -> MAGNET_OFF/status-confirm. physical_pick_verified remains false until post-move visual evidence.
sources.motion: The first controller write after opening is the direct HOME set_pose command; Q1 does not send CMD_SET_GLOBAL_ACC. Current Cartesian and joint feedback have both failed to provide a usable production arrival signal on this arm. The sequence therefore uses each controller duration followed by a 200 ms mechanical settle before continuing, matching the active pintu executor timing. No feedback wait or movement timeout can block camera initialization or the move queue. K230 initialization performs protocol handshakes without a discarded warmup capture; the next and only capture is the image used for scene analysis and planning.
sources.target_geometry: The official Figure 2 template remains 100x60 mm. Run 20260731_012300_357937 measured the four fixed source polygons at 6375.18 mm2 versus the nominal 6000 mm2, giving a 1.0308 linear ratio. Q1 uses target_scale=1.03 for this physical four-piece set. edge_gap_enabled=true applies edge_gap_mm=5 as rigid per-piece translations that make all five adjacent-edge normal gaps 5 mm; edge_gap_enabled=false keeps the original target template with no added gap. The target remains centered at paper [105,222.75] mm. Planned corresponding-vertex distances with the gap enabled are at most 10.69 mm, below the official 20 mm limit.

_note: Single active source for NexArm, camera and STM32 magnet endpoints, arm calibration, HOME, motion and planning parameters. Production Q1 is STM32-only; real energization still requires --confirm RUN_Q1. The main sequence uses controller duration plus a fixed mechanical settle before switching the magnet.
